definitions.explanation: The act of deceiving someone to gain money or other benefits illegally.

examples.japanese: {詐欺|さぎ}{事件|じけん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{増|ふ}えている。
{詐欺|さぎ}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{逮捕|たいほ}される。

notes:
{詐欺|さぎ} refers to fraud or swindling.

COMMON TYPES:
- {振|ふ}り{込|こ}め{詐欺|さぎ}: bank transfer fraud (phone scam)
- {投資|とうし}{詐欺|さぎ}: investment fraud
- {結婚|けっこん}{詐欺|さぎ}: marriage fraud
- {保険|ほけん}{詐欺|さぎ}: insurance fraud

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {詐欺|さぎ}に{遭|あ}う (to fall victim to fraud)
- {詐欺|さぎ}を{働|はたら}く (to commit fraud)
- {詐欺|さぎ}{師|し} (con artist, swindler)
- {詐欺|さぎ}{罪|ざい} (fraud charge)

NOTE: Do not confuse with {鷺|さぎ} (heron), which has the same reading.
